name: Result API
description:
Result is one workspace for running a business. This document describes its HTTP API: the operations behind identifying an account, reading where it is in signing up, creating a business, and crossing from result.dev to the product at app.result.dev with the session intact.

Every operation requires a bearer token and there is no anonymous surface, by design.

To OPERATE a Result business — read its numbers, work its pipeline, publish, answer support — use the Model Context Protocol server at https://app.result.dev/mcp rather than this API. It exposes the same tools the product uses internally, under the same permission checks, and it is the interface built for agents.

Both hosts answer these paths. `https://result.dev/api/...` is rewritten to the product, same-origin, which is how this site's own signup calls avoid CORS entirely.
